description: Structured, role-aware messaging for the whole care team — with read receipts and escalation.
notes: Demo thread: metformin titration debate across PCP/pharmacist/nurse/family
shared/kit.js + kit.css empty at build time; full Kit fallback inlined

notes.note: Phone tag and fax in care coordination is a real disgrace, and a shared role-aware inbox with read receipts is exactly the boring software that sells. Home-health agencies pay per seat and churn slowly. Unsexy, real, fundable.
Inbox threads, new-thread composer, escalate flow; zero errors.

notes.change: Added response-time SLA timers per thread with auto-escalation on breach; hero now states the SLA promise.
